title: Orange Bowl Playoff, Dec. 2018: Alabama 45, Oklahoma 34
question: What was the score when Oklahoma played Alabama in the Orange Bowl playoff semifinal?
answer: Alabama beat Oklahoma 45-34 in the College Football Playoff semifinal at the Orange Bowl on December 29, 2018. The top-ranked Tide led 28-0 early in the second quarter before Kyler Murray led an OU rally.
summary: No. 1 Alabama beat No. 4 Oklahoma 45-34 in the Dec. 29, 2018 Orange Bowl semifinal after leading 28-0, despite 417 total yards from Kyler Murray.
body: The 2018 Sooners carried the nation's top-ranked offense and quarterback Kyler Murray into Hard Rock Stadium in Miami Gardens as the playoff's No. 4 seed. Waiting for them was unbeaten, No. 1 Alabama and quarterback Tua Tagovailoa.

The start could hardly have gone worse. Alabama scored touchdowns on its first four possessions and led 28-0 early in the second quarter, racking up 200 yards in the first quarter while holding Oklahoma to 13 yards on its first three drives. The Tide took a 31-10 lead into halftime.

Then OU fought back. The Sooners outscored Alabama 24-14 after halftime, closing to 31-20 entering the fourth quarter. Murray completed 19 of 37 passes for 308 yards and two touchdowns and ran 17 times for 109 yards and another score, giving him 417 total yards. Both teams scored twice in the fourth quarter, and Alabama held on.

Tagovailoa was nearly flawless, completing 24 of 27 passes for 318 yards and four touchdowns, and shared MVP honors with safety Xavier McKinney. Alabama moved on to face Clemson for the title, while Oklahoma fell to 0-3 in playoff semifinals, with losses following the 2015, 2017 and 2018 seasons.
